scope: Original 27B16k x1 arms; exact logical batches; metadata-only exploratory associations, not per-example blame or causality.

identity.proof: Rebuilt domain interleave equals persisted material_ids in both arms; frozen trainer shuffles with seed+epoch_number, then slices8; microbatch sorting only permutes each slice; no dropped rows/resume.

limitations: source_tokens are generator-tokenizer counts of required source units, not total retrieved evidence or actual encoder input lengths; those per-training-item lengths were not persisted.
answer_tokens are stored generator-tokenizer bare-answer counts, not exact reader answer-mask spans.
Eight-example gradient is aggregated; family presence does not identify the example that caused a spike.
Logical membership is shared; ratio-dependent physical microbatch sorting and penalty assignment can differ.
One seed and many correlated descriptive comparisons; no significance or causal claim.
